source: &296 A young corpsman, probably fairly new. She surveys the perimeter, ensuring no curious members of the public have breached the cordon.
target: &296 一名年轻警员，大概刚入职不久。她巡视着周边，确保没有好奇的市民越过警戒线。

source: &307 The pattern on her arm suggests she's a rookie - it's probably her (slightly) more highly-ranked colleague who's had operational command until your arrival.
target: &307 她手臂上的标识表明她还是新人。你来之前，应该是那位级别稍高一点的同事在现场指挥。

source: &308 Empty platforms at this time of night - a sure sign that something's gone terribly wrong, but reassuringly that the corpsmen on the scene have begun evacuations.
target: &308 这个时间，站台却空无一人，肯定是出了大事。不过，这至少说明现场警员已经开始疏散人群。

source: &334 From down on the ground, that type of drone's unreachable - that's part of its purpose.
target: &334 从地面上够不着这种无人机，这本来就是设计它的目的之一。

source: &335 Even the drones are helping to evacuate commuters from the station.
target: &335 连无人机都在帮忙疏散站里的乘客。
